title: If You Gotta. . .
text: If You Gotta. . .. First I read the instructions  which said 'install 4 AA batteries, then aim the product at the can and hit the button, and you can simply watch as it opens' I tried this and the can opener sat there aimed at the can making whirring noises. Nothing happened. Next I actually tried putting the opener on the can and it took some finagling but in the end it opened the can easier than the manual crank opener I have. Storing is a pain, it's oversize and takes up a lot of drawer or counter space. If you need an opener like this then you do. I wasn't crazy about it and I'll use my small manual for as long as I'm able.
